x: If you finished further down the field than 11th in the Club 10 mile cross country championship you will not thank the 'Grapevine' authors for reminding you that DENNIS JONES has been a grandfather for the past 18 months! Of course that makes BILL JONES a great-grandfather - doesn't seem possible does it.

First away was Arthur Welling, followed by Bill Jones and in quick succession the rest of the field of 54 starters. Before the windmill was reached it was pretty obvious that as far as Jones was concerned the handicapper had dropped a "clanger" ..... winning with seconds to spare from W.

When he moved to Ursula Street he lived next door but one to Dennis Jones and his father Bill Jones. They were two life long Belgrave members, and it was they who persuaded Ted to join the club in February 1957.
